_readme: Single source of truth for the docs site. No other file hardcodes a version number.
'ref' is the git ref whose docs/ folder supplies that version's content;
'.' means this working tree (which is main when the site is built in CI).
To publish a new series: tag the release, add an entry at the top of 'versions',
and point 'latest' at it. Everything else — banners, switcher, footers — follows.
A release tag is the usual ref, but it carries the docs as they stood when the
installers were cut. Where a series' docs were finished after its last release
(0.11, 0.12), point it at a 'docs-<series>' tag instead — never move a release
tag, its GitHub release holds the downloads.
